title: The Urban life of the young
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：urban　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 urban 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of ① an urban life of the young in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so urban that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the urban ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the urban life of the young that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too urban to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the urban ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an urban plan for the district, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as urban as the plan for the district they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was urban or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something urban, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite urban; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the urban ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, in public, she wrote of another urban life of the young in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less urban than anybody had expected. ⑩ The urban plan for the district that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the urban ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 城市（前置定语 an urban life of the young：1974 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件城市的生活）
B. adj. 城市／都市（两处加强说法：so urban that … 与 no less urban than …）
C. adj. 城市／都市（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 城市（表语 too urban to do：母亲觉得它太城市，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 都市（前置定语 an urban plan for the district：叔叔把整件事称作一桩都市的规划）
F. adj. 都市（同级比较 as urban as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这个城区的规划相比）
G. adj. 都市（后置定语 something urban：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 都市（受程度副词修饰 quite urban：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an urban life of the young
the urban life of the young that
an urban plan for the district
The urban plan for the district that

answers.why: urban 意为“城市”，1974 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件城市的生活”，此处作前置定语 an urban life of the young。
urban 意为“城市”，此处用 so urban that 结构，说它城市到工坊里没人敢靠近。
urban 意为“城市”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的城市年轻人的城市生活，等于最高级的说法。
urban 意为“城市”，母亲认为这件东西“太城市了，谁也用不上”，too urban to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
urban 意为“都市”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩都市的规划”，此处作前置定语 an urban plan for the district。
urban 意为“都市”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这个城区的规划一样都市”，同级比较用 as urban as。
urban 意为“都市”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“都市的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something urban。
urban 意为“都市”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当都市”，quite 修饰原级 urban。
urban 意为“都市”，no less urban than 表示“其都市不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之都市不亚于任何人的预料。
urban 意为“都市”，母亲 1986 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的都市规划”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件城市的生活。（an urban life of the young）
它城市到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so urban that …）
母亲觉得它太城市，谁也用不上。（too urban to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩都市的规划。（an urban plan for the district）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这个城区的规划一样都市。（as urban as …）
到了 1981 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件都市的东西。（something urban）
answers: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of an urban life of the young in the ledger.
It was so urban that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too urban to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an urban plan for the district.
He said nobody would call it as urban as the plan for the district they had once had.
By 1981 the ledger asked for nothing but something urban.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 urban 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of an urban life of the young in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the urban life of the young that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too urban to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an urban plan for the district, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite urban, and everybody laughed.
The urban ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
